title: Fixture-only Research Console usability acknowledgement
acceptance_conditions: Dense dark 16:9 product shell converges materially toward the operator reference without copying reference data as facts.

Persistent left navigation rail, investigation tabs/top controls, context-and-authority summary band, three-column research workspace, right evidence inspector and bottom evidence/change strip are all present and proportionally coherent.
Primary market/structure canvas is visually dominant; surrounding panels have compact enterprise density rather than large unused gutters.
SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE, NON_EVIDENTIARY and AUTHORITY EFFECT NONE remain persistent and legible.
Healthy, inactive-C2E, null/residual, authority-denied and dense fixture states remain understandable without fabricating source state.
C2E absence is shown honestly as NOT_MATERIALIZED with source reason rather than legacy substitution.
AVAILABLE, AUTHORISED and ACTIVE remain visibly independent.
1920x1080, 1440x810 and 1280x720 retain critical labels and usable primary-canvas height.
Interaction controls remain navigation/presentation only and cannot mutate evidence or authority.
Operator explicitly accepts the remediated visual/usability baseline at a renewed RCN-G3V review.
